title: Imbalanced Loss-Integrated Deep-Learning-Based Ultrasound Image Analysis for Diagnosis of Rotator-Cuff Tear
summary: The SMART-CA fully convolutional network with an integrated positive-loss function segmented rotator-cuff tears in ultrasound images. The study reports improved precision, recall and Dice metrics over comparison approaches; clinical impact and independent prospective performance were not established.
ai_technology: A deep-learning ultrasound-image model classifies rotator-cuff tears; the study evaluates the diagnosis with clinical images.
